# pdns_tsig_key (Resource)

Manages a PowerDNS TSIG key. The secret is supplied either through `key` (stored in state) or through the write-only `key_wo` (never stored in state or plan; requires Terraform >= 1.11 or OpenTofu >= 1.11). Attach the key to zones with `pdns_zone_tsig_key`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Secret stored in state.
resource "pdns_tsig_key" "tenant_a" {
  name      = "tenant-a"
  algorithm = "hmac-sha256"
  key       = var.tenant_a_tsig_secret
}

# Secret passed write-only: never stored in plan or state.
# Requires Terraform >= 1.11 or OpenTofu >= 1.11.
variable "tenant_b_tsig_secret" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
  ephemeral = true
}

resource "pdns_tsig_key" "tenant_b" {
  name   = "tenant-b"
  key_wo = var.tenant_b_tsig_secret
  # Bump to roll out a new secret.
  key_wo_version = 1
}

# Generated secret, write-only: an ephemeral resource creates a fresh random
# value on every run, but it is only sent to PowerDNS on create or when
# `key_wo_version` changes. Pass the same ephemeral value to another
# write-only argument (e.g. of a secret store) to hand it to the tenant.
# Requires hashicorp/random >= 3.7.0.
ephemeral "random_password" "tenant_c" {
  length = 32
}

resource "pdns_tsig_key" "tenant_c" {
  name           = "tenant-c"
  key_wo         = base64encode(ephemeral.random_password.tenant_c.result)
  key_wo_version = 1
}

# Generated secret, stored in state: readable later via the `key` attribute.
resource "random_bytes" "tenant_d" {
  length = 32
}

resource "pdns_tsig_key" "tenant_d" {
  name = "tenant-d"
  key  = random_bytes.tenant_d.base64
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the TSIG key. This is the key name clients (e.g. `nsupdate`, external-dns) must use. Changing it forces a new key.

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `algorithm` (String) The HMAC algorithm of the key. One of `hmac-md5`, `hmac-sha1`, `hmac-sha224`, `hmac-sha256`, `hmac-sha384`, `hmac-sha512`. Defaults to `hmac-sha256`. Changing it forces a new key.
- `key` (String, Sensitive) The base64 encoded secret of the key. Stored in state. Exactly one of `key` or `key_wo` must be set.
- `key_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) The base64 encoded secret of the key as a write-only attribute: it is never stored in plan or state. Must be used together with `key_wo_version`; bump the version to roll out a new secret. Exactly one of `key` or `key_wo` must be set.
- `key_wo_version` (Number) Version of `key_wo`. As write-only values are not stored, changing this value is what triggers an update of the secret.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The PowerDNS ID of the TSIG key (usually the name with a trailing dot). Use this to attach the key to zones.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# TSIG keys are imported by their PowerDNS id (the name with a trailing dot).
terraform import pdns_tsig_key.tenant_a tenant-a.
```
